text: In the three days since the last run (7 November), electronics (about +1,220 reviews) and beauty (about +1,130) moved most on Amazon, led by OnePlus earphones (+137 and +113) and Ghar Soaps bath bars (+143), while Diwali string lights were still gaining reviews, likely from buyers reviewing after the festival. For a beginner, sling and crossbody bags, simple toys and small fitness items look most reachable, because big brands lead almost everything else.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, Banarasi and Kanjivaram sarees rise
text: Kurta sets from GoSriKi and Klosia have the most reviews, and a ₹799 Klosia Anarkali set gained the most in three days (+67), with Nermosa and Parthvi sets next (+25 each); the category added about 410 reviews. Banarasi and Kanjivaram-style sarees from Yashika, C J Enterprise and SGF11 are new or rising, which likely fits the wedding season. The typical price is about ₹699, and the top 10 products have about 11.9% 1-star reviews, the highest on Amazon. Sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Women's western: Amazon's Symbol leads, party dresses and Korean-style tops rise
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have by far the most reviews, followed by Leriya Fashion dresses. Growth was small, about 150 reviews in three days, with a ₹599 Shasmi maxi dress marketed for New Year parties (+16) and a ₹329 Kzully maxi dress (+15) gaining most. Embroidered Korean-style tops from Rieka around ₹650 to ₹700 are rising, and oversized T-shirts and ribbed tops are new to the list. The typical price is about ₹498, and the top 10 have about 10.5% 1-star reviews, so sizes and fit are a real risk.

headline: Men's clothing: big brands lead, jackets and hoodies rise with winter
text: Allen Solly, Van Heusen and Amazon's Symbol lead with polo T-shirts, and an Allen Solly sweatshirt leads winter wear. A ₹549 Lymio lightweight jacket gained the most in three days (+41), and hooded jackets and Boldfit zipper hoodies are rising, which fits the start of winter. The category added only about 320 reviews, the typical price is about ₹509, and the top 10 have about 8.9% 1-star reviews. Strong brands plus sizes make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: Uno and soft toys lead, girls' co-ord sets arrive
text: A ₹97 Uno card game has the most reviews, followed by an ₹89 Babique rattle soft toy and the ₹156 Uno No Mercy game. Growth was small, about 210 reviews in three days, led by a ₹1,539 Kidsmate tricycle (+16), a ₹186 dancing monkey toy and a ₹349 set of 24 die-cast cars (+13 each), likely early gift buying for Children's Day and Christmas. Girls' winter and ethnic co-ord sets are new on the clothing list but still have few reviews. The top 10 have only about 5% 1-star reviews; Mattel leads card games, but simple unbranded toys are reachable for a beginner.

headline: Home & kitchen: Pigeon and Milton lead, Diwali lights still collecting reviews
text: A ₹189 Pigeon mini chopper has the most reviews by far, followed by Milton steel bottles and a ₹152 Ajanta clock. In three days, DesiDiya and One94Store LED string lights (+58 to +73) and a ₹259 Aliston kitchen scale (+51) gained most; the lights are likely being reviewed after Diwali and their demand should now fade. New to the list are a steel dish rack, a steel chopping board, anti-slip fridge mats and a pressure cooker combo. The typical price is about ₹299, and the top 10 have about 9.1% 1-star reviews; small kitchen tools are a good beginner route, but avoid competing head-on with Pigeon and Milton.

headline: Beauty: Dettol, Vaseline and Nivea lead, winter body lotions arrive
text: Big brands lead: Dettol handwash refills, Vaseline, Cetaphil and Nivea. In three days, Ghar Soaps bath bars (+143), Cetaphil face wash (+98) and The Derma Co face wash (+68) gained most, and new Vaseline and Parachute body lotions likely reflect winter dry skin. The category added about 1,130 reviews, second on Amazon, the typical price is about ₹270, and the top 10 have about 5.7% 1-star reviews. Demand is strong but brand-led, so a beginner would need brand approval or their own brand.

headline: Jewellery: small, slow list, YouBella and Shining Diva lead
text: Only 32 products were read, and the Women's Jewellery list added almost nothing (about 370 reviews in total), so treat this category with care. YouBella bracelets, earrings and American diamond sets and Shining Diva sets lead at about ₹165 to ₹345, and growth in three days was tiny (about 32 reviews in total). New items include a Sukkhi gold plated necklace, a bridal hair brooch and Rajasthani lac bangles, which likely fits the wedding season. The top 10 have about 9.5% 1-star reviews; jewellery is light and has no sizes, but Amazon buyers review it much less than Meesho buyers.

headline: Bags & footwear: orthopedic slippers lead, crossbody bags rise
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers have the most reviews, and Lavie handbags lead bags at about ₹1,299. The category showed no net growth since the last run (about −24 reviews, likely because the list changed and Amazon recounted reviews), though Doctor Extra Soft and Ortho Joy slippers (+19, +14) and a ₹529 Walizza sling bag (+11) still gained. Walizza and Lyrovo crossbody bags around ₹480 to ₹530 are rising, and more orthopedic slippers from Frido and Doctor Health are new. The typical price is about ₹564 and the top 10 have about 8.7% 1-star reviews; bags have no sizes, so they suit a beginner better than shoes.

headline: Electronics: OnePlus, JBL and boAt lead, phone cases and cables rise
text: OnePlus, JBL, boAt and realme earphones have the most reviews by far. Electronics gained the most reviews of any Amazon category (about +1,220 in three days), led by OnePlus neckband and earbuds (+137, +113), Apple EarPods (+69) and a ₹299 Portronics wired earphone (+63). Samsung chargers and cables, Portronics adaptors and phone cases for new phones like the Galaxy A17 are new or rising. The typical price is about ₹637 and the top 10 have about 9.3% 1-star reviews; brands dominate, so only simple phone cases suit a beginner.

headline: Health & fitness: Philips and Havells lead, pull-up bars and dumbbells rise
text: Personal care is led by Dettol, Havells and Philips, and a Philips men's trimmer gained the most in three days (+88), with a ₹235 WishCare tinted lip balm and a Havells trimmer (+39 each). On the fitness side, ₹445 Lifelong dumbbells (+35) moved, and Slovic and Lifelong pull-up bars are rising, likely home-gym buying for winter. The typical price is about ₹399 and the top 10 have about 4.7% 1-star reviews, the lowest on Amazon. Trimmers and dryers are brand-led, so a beginner should look at simple fitness accessories.

Crossbody and sling bags around ₹480 to ₹530
Simple toys such as dancing toys and die-cast car sets around ₹190 to ₹350
Pull-up bars and small home-gym accessories around ₹450 to ₹550
Small kitchen tools such as dish racks and steel chopping boards
Phone cases for new phone models around ₹300
Traditional jewellery such as lac bangles and kundan sets around ₹190 to ₹300

Avoid for now: earbuds, chargers and trimmers (OnePlus, JBL, boAt, Samsung, Philips and Havells lead), branded skincare and lotions, men's branded T-shirts, and Diwali lights and diyas whose demand likely ends now that the festival is over.
